profile.name: A2D 可编程直流电子负载
profile.description: 一种可编程直流电子负载，通过吸收设定电流对电源、电池及其他直流输出进行测试。实验中常用于负载调节、输出电压与电流测量、温度监测，以及电压和电流校准，并支持通过 RS485 进行设备寻址。
profile.description_en: A programmable DC electronic load that sinks a set current to test power supplies, batteries, and other DC sources. In the lab it is used for load regulation, output voltage and current measurement, temperature monitoring, and voltage/current calibration, with device addressing over RS485.

registry.name: A/D Electronic Load
registry.description: A/D Electronic Load是由A/D Instruments生产的电池测试柜，主要功能包括初始化、复位、数据保存、校准、测量、电流设置。支持Signal, Slot, get cal i等操作。
